prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- For best combination of price, selection and reliable installation: check Discount Tire (large selection, good techs) and Costco Tire Center (very competitive price, good installation — membership required).
- For warranty work, inspections and full-service care: consider Firestone Complete Auto Care or your dealer.
- For personalized attention and sometimes better installation care (road-force balancing, careful TPMS work): pick a well-rated local independent tire shop with ASE-certified techs.

How to pick where to buy/install (quick checklist)
1. Price + selection: compare online (Tire Rack, SimpleTire) vs local stores (Discount Tire, Costco, dealer). Online can be cheaper but you still need a local installer.
2. Installation quality: ask whether they do road-force balancing (recommended for highway/low-profile tires), TPMS service, valve/stem replacement, proper torque specs, and final test drive.
3. Warranties & service: get written info on mounting fees, balancing, lifetime rotations, and road hazard warranties.
4. Reviews & credentials: choose shops with lots of recent 4–5 star Google/Yelp reviews and ASE- or (if relevant) manufacturer-trained technicians.
5. Turnaround & convenience: some places do same-day installs by appointment (Discount Tire often), Costco can have longer waits.

Typical good options (what most drivers choose)
- Discount Tire: wide selection, usually excellent installation service and same-day installs.
- Costco Tire Center: often best price per tire + reputable installation; requires Costco membership.
- Firestone Complete Auto Care / Pep Boys: nationwide chains that do solid installs and handle warranty work.
- Local independent shops: often best for personal service, careful install and follow-up — look for ASE-certified techs and lots of positive local reviews.

- Compare prices for a specific tire size/model (tell me vehicle year/make/model or tire size and whether you want all-season, summer, winter, or performance tires).

Which car and tire type are you buying? That will let me give a tailored list of nearby places and the best installer choice.
